The proposed persistence flow keeps temporary output, flush or equivalent durability handling, and atomic replacement rather than direct writes to the final path.
The proposed failure handling removes temporary output and preserves the previously valid document.
The verification plan covers rejected boundary input and an interrupted or failed persistence path in addition to successful import behavior.
